page_title: MON 2-1 HEI | B. Monchengladbach v Heidenheim 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+5' Kevin Muller makes a good save! Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
90+5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Florian Pick (Heidenheim).
90+3' Heidenheim are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
90' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
89' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
87' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Jordan Siebatcheu will be replaced by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) is coming onto the pitch as Rocco Reitz cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' The manager makes a subsitution with Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) coming on for Lennard Maloney.
82' Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to gather the ball.
81' Heidenheim keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.

78' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Robert Hartmann with no other option than to blow for a foul.
77' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) picks up a yellow card.
76' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Alassane Plea is replaced by Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach).
75' Substitution. Franck Honorat walks off the pitch and Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) comes on as a substitute.
75' The substitution has been made. Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) has replaced Nathan Ngoumou.
70' A substitution has been made. Norman Theuerkauf goes off and Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) comes on.
70' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) replacing Jan-Niklas Beste.

70' What a save from Moritz Nicolas! Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
68' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

65' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) receives a precise pass from his teammate and sends a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, he didn't manage to aim well enough and the ball flies just narrowly wide of the right post.
64' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
61' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
59' PENALTY APPEAL by Heidenheim, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
58' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) is able to continue to play.
56' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
56' The foul by Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) was seen by Robert Hartmann who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
52' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
52' 2 - 1 Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) attempts to head the ball away from inside the six-yard box, but unluckily he turns a cross from the resulting corner inside the right post of his own net.
50' The referee blows his whistle as Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) was too aggressive in his challenge.
48' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
48' The Heidenheim players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) is replaced by Marnon Busch.
46' Frank Schmidt makes a half-time substitution. Florian Pick (Heidenheim) comes on in place of Adrian Beck.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Hartmann had an easy-decision to make.
45+2' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Some great controlled play and passing from Heidenheim. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
42' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) releases Norman Theuerkauf, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
38' 1 - 1 Goal! Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the left post. It's 1:1.
37' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to send the ball in.

37' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Kevin Muller thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
35' Corner kick. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity.
34' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

33' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
30' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) plants a goal-bound header towards the right post after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders reacts superbly and makes a timely interception.
30' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
28' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
26' It's a throw-in for Heidenheim.
23' B. Monchengladbach are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
20' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

20' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the roof of the net. Moritz Nicolas guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
19' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
16' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) dribbles his way into the box and has an effort on goal, but the ball flies well wide of the right post.
13' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
11' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
7' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:0.
3' B. Monchengladbach force a corner. They send men into the box.
3' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
1' The first half has started.
B. Monchengladbach will kick the game off.
